items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: my godfather... used to take me to the – downtown to the Paramount to see Gene Krupa’s band... I liked him a lot, and his band, at that particular time.

ctx.x: What was your first interest in music? What’s your first instrument that got you?

The drums, the drums. That was where I – my godfather, Mr. Cobbs, Daddy Cobbs, he used to take me to the – downtown to the Paramount to see Gene Krupa’s band when he came to town and played down there. That was real exciting for me. I thought he was great, the way he approached drumming, and of course the way they set him up. They used to throw two spots on him. He would be a huge shadow of him over there. He’d be there. Then there’d be a huge shadow of him there, and a huge shadow there, and then one behind him,…
Have you ever actually played drums yourself?
